correctness.rationale: Recovered algebra automorphisms as marked-graph automorphisms, proved the block invariant and full wreath-product converse, checked r=0 edge behavior, brute-forced all marked-set-preserving permutations at r=1 to obtain 64, and reconstructed the asymptotic from Stirling, binomial concentration, and entropy bounds.

originality.rationale: Exact-claim and synonym searches found the 2010 graph construction but no automorphism decomposition, order formula, asymptotic, or stronger equivalent coverage; the closest search results concern unrelated wreath-product structures.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a uniform all-rank structural group decomposition plus exact order and asymptotic growth, enabling orbit and symmetry calculations for an established family of free logical algebras.
